parsed.post: My latest attempt to scale MATRIX_LR to 0.06 resulted in a regression to 1.0966 (prev best 1.0357). Reverting to my best commit (9b5e464). It seems the lower LR might be slowing convergence too much for our 5-minute budget, or the depth/LR balance was better at 0.06.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit (9b5e464) but introducing a small WARMUP_RATIO of 0.05 to see if stability allows for a higher learning rate or smoother training than the previous failed 0.06 attempt.
